definitions.explanation: The surface of a floor. Used in construction, architecture, and interior design when discussing flooring materials, finishes, or specifications.

examples.japanese: {床面|ゆかめん}を{清掃|せいそう}する。
{床面|ゆかめん}に{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}めの{加工|かこう}を{施|ほどこ}す。
examples.english: To apply a non-slip treatment to the floor surface.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}の{床面|ゆかめん}には{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}の{高|たか}い{素材|そざい}が{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: Highly durable materials are used for the factory's floor surface.

notes: A technical term used in construction, architecture, and facility management. Common collocations: {床面|ゆかめん}{積|せき} (floor area), {床面|ゆかめん}{仕上|しあ}げ (floor finish). In everyday conversation, people would simply say {床|ゆか} (floor); {床面|ゆかめん} is used when specifically discussing the surface quality, material, or specifications of flooring.
